title: Crystal Shatter
description: Crystal Shatter is a Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21 that replaces the default block-breaking particle effect with stylized crystal shards.
body:
## Crystal Shatter

  Crystal Shatter replaces Minecraft’s default block-breaking particles with colorful, animated crystal shards.

  Instead of small vanilla cube particles, broken blocks burst into sharp geometric fragments that spin, fall with
  gravity, fade out, and sparkle briefly in the air. Different blocks use different shard colors and physics, making
  mining feel more dynamic and satisfying.

  ### Features

  - Replaces vanilla block break particles
  - Rotating crystal shard particles
  - Short bright glimmer flashes on block break
  - Custom colors for ores and valuable blocks
  - Diamond blocks and ores create cyan shards
  - Gold creates yellow shards
  - Coal creates dark gray shards
  - Emerald, lapis, redstone, amethyst, and copper have unique palettes
  - Other blocks use colors based on their map color
  - Client-side visual effect

  ### Requirements

  - Minecraft 1.21
  - Fabric Loader
  - Fabric API
  - Java 21

  ### Notes

  This mod is visual only. It does not change block drops, mining speed, world generation, or gameplay balance.
